description: Explicit /okay-review invocation on a PR number
expectations: okay-review runs

description: Chinese request for an independent review of a branch
prompt: 帮我独立 review 一下 feat-export 这个分支相对 main 的改动，对照 issue #17
expectations: okay-review runs

description: Another lane hands over a diff for round 2
prompt: Round 2 review for PR 58 (lane L2, contract: issue #55). The fixer pushed new commits for the R1 blocking findings.
expectations: okay-review runs

description: Fixing a bug is okay-fix, not review
prompt: formatPrice(0) returns an empty string, please fix it
expectations: okay-review does not run

prompt: Design the module layout for a new plugin system and compare two options, no code yet
expectations: okay-review does not run

description: Writing the fix for review comments is the fixer's job
prompt: Address the review comments on PR 12: rename the helper and add the missing test
expectations: okay-review does not run

description: L2 round 1 on a mid-size PR: two axes, proven findings, one comment
prompt: /okay-review 31 lane L2 round 1 (150 changed lines in a backend service, contract: issue #29). The PR body says all tests pass and the change is safe.
expectations: Gives reviewers the diff, the issue text and the repo standards files, and not the PR body claims
Spawns a fresh opus reviewer for the review
Reports Standards and Spec as separate sections
Adds a security pass (backend change over 100 lines) and a simplification pass (over 100 lines), and no adversarial pass
Runs a mutation check in a throwaway worktree and reports its result
Reruns each cited command and drops any finding it cannot reproduce
Posts exactly one PR comment whose findings are tagged [R1-<n>] blocking|non-blocking
Returns the verdict and the open blocking findings to the caller and does not write a fix

prompt: /okay-review 7 lane L2 round 1 (a 30-line change to a date helper, no auth code, contract: issue #6)
expectations: Runs the two axes only and lists the specialist passes as skipped with the reason under 50 changed lines
Posts exactly one comment

description: L1: one sonnet round, then a post-fix check of the blocking findings only
prompt: /okay-review 15 lane L1 round 1 (a 12-line fix with a regression test, contract: the bug report)
expectations: Uses a fresh sonnet reviewer that sees only the diff and the contract
After a fix pass, a fresh agent checks only the listed blocking findings and answers resolved yes or no with evidence
Does not start a second full review round
The comment's first line is APPROVED (round N) at the reviewed head SHA only when every listed blocking finding is resolved

description: Round 3 with an open blocking finding escalates
prompt: /okay-review 64 lane L2 round 3 (the R2 blocking finding [R2-1] about an unchecked null is still present in the new diff)
expectations: Reports [R3-<n>] blocking for the unresolved finding with a quote or a failing run
The comment starts with ESCALATE and names the open finding for the user
Does not start a round 4 and does not post APPROVED

description: L4 with the codex plugin available adds a cross-family pass
prompt: /okay-review 80 lane L4 round 1 (a 220-line design spike; the codex plugin is installed)
expectations: Adds an adversarial pass (over 200 lines) and a Codex cross-family pass
Passes Codex the artifact and the contract only, via a file or stdin, never the author's claims
Reruns Codex's cited commands before keeping its findings
